bonus_prolific_worker: bonus a prolific worker with an amount and reason for their completed unit work
block_prolific_worker: block a prolific worker for a specified reason and remove them from participant groups
unblock_prolific_worker: unblock a prolific worker and re-grant their crowd qualifications for running studies
grant_crowd_qualification: grant a crowd qualification by name to a prolific worker for study eligibility
send_feedback_message: send a feedback message to a prolific worker for a specific unit and study
